name: Clear Bell (Thanh Linh)
lore: The mistress's own bell, cast in 1128 on the night the hall was given to her, from the bronze of the bell that cracked in the pour and killed the founder in 1060. It rings a note no other bell in the south can match, and every bell line on the roads has been retuned to it.
build_use: The bell-caster's ward: long wards, soul resistance and a slowing ring.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Banner of the Root Line (Căn Tuyến Kỳ)
lore: A long banner of bamboo paper painted with the hall's bell lines, each bell a dot of bronze leaf. When a bell rings anywhere on the roads, its dot warms. The mistress has added a dot for every bell she has hung since 1105, and some dots are on no road the hall admits to.
build_use: A warning array: sight, evasion and faster Wood arts.

name: The Last Blue Lamp (Thanh Đăng)
lore: The last bronze lamp cast at Thanh Đăng Trấn before the Night Rain Edict put the Tower's lamps out (C167). Chung Thiết Liên made it in 904 and carried it south unlit in 930. His son keeps it on his tea table and has not lit it.

name: Bell-Caster's Apron (Chú Linh Bào)
lore: A leather casting apron scorched through in a hundred places. She wore it at every pour since 1030, the one in 1060 that killed the founder included.
build_use: The bronze pour for whoever comes too close.
